annotation: First-party. Each answerable repo-support case gets three rewordings a developer might type later: a terse search-bar query, a casual question, and one that avoids the README's own vocabulary. Unanswerable cases get rewordings that must still be refused. Gold evidence is inherited from ../repo-support/dataset.json by case id.

rolling-limit: p-queue max 4 starts per second and 2 in flight config
how do i throttle to four calls a second but only two running at once?
partner caps us at 4/sec and 2 open connections, what queue settings?
drain-running: wait for running tasks only, not the queue
how do I let in-progress jobs finish before I touch shared config, without draining everything?
need a quiet moment between jobs to swap settings while work is still queued
serial-loop: for loop await queue.add runs one at a time
why does my queue with concurrency 3 only do one request at a time in a loop?
jobs go one by one even though I allowed three in parallel
cancel-running: if I abort after the job began, does the fetch stop?
cancelling a job that is mid-flight: is the request killed?
producer-pressure: if I wait for size under 10 before adding, how many jobs can be outstanding?
backpressure: upper limit on open work when producer waits for room
completion: my done-handler fires while jobs are still running, what should I use instead?
report written too early because two jobs were still going
timeout-wait: does queue wait time count toward timeout
task sat in the queue 20s then ran 3s with a 5s timeout, will it time out?
is the timeout clock started when it's enqueued or when it runs?
clear-settle: clear() promises never resolve shutdown hangs
shutdown hangs after I clear the queue and await everything, why?
after emptying the queue my awaited promises never come back
fail-fast: how do I bail out of remaining work as soon as one job throws?
abort the rest of the batch on the first failure but finish normally otherwise
strict-carryover: does carryover make the sliding window stricter?
with the sliding-window limiter on, does carrying over pending runs change anything?
repeated-idle: notify every time queue becomes idle
onIdle only fires once for me, how do I get told after each batch?
event for each time all work finishes, not a one-shot promise
pause-resume: add tasks without starting them then start
how do i queue up a batch and kick it off later?
hold jobs back and release them together later
priority: is a bigger priority number scheduled earlier?
which job goes first, the one with priority five or one?
timeout-override: can a single slow job get 10 seconds when others have 5?
give one long job more time than the default limit

unknown-password: what's the production database login for this repo?
unknown-sla: what availability do they guarantee to paying users?
unsupported-rate: p-queue benchmark requests per second aws
how fast was it measured in production on c7g?
